name: Local 3DGS Optimization
definition: An iterative optimization process to estimate the camera pose (transformation) between two nearby images by optimizing a local 3D Gaussian Splatting representation against photometric loss, while keeping the Gaussian attributes fixed after initialization.
summary: Local 3DGS Optimization estimates relative camera pose by optimizing a local 3D Gaussian Splatting representation against photometric loss, distinguishing itself by freezing Gaussian attributes and learning only pose parameters.
